title: Admins edit a public tag group, only its owner makes it public or personal
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  • User B: a teammate who is not an admin.
  • User B owns a public tag group "ZZ Public team" (with a member), a personal tag group "ZZ Personal team" (Public off), and a quick note "ZZ Note".
  • User C: a second non-admin teammate.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as User A (admin), open the Tag groups tab, and open "ZZ Public team" to edit it.
  2. Look at the Public tag group toggle; rename the group (e.g. "ZZ Public team 2"), change its members, and save.
  3. Look for "ZZ Personal team" and User B's quick note "ZZ Note", and for any way to reach User B's Preferences.
  4. Sign in as User C and look for edit or delete on "ZZ Public team 2".
  5. Sign in as User B, open "ZZ Public team 2", switch Public tag group off, save; then delete it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The admin can rename the public group and change its members; delete is also offered to them.
  • For the admin the Public tag group toggle shows on and is disabled: only the owner can switch it.
  • The admin cannot see or reach User B's personal group, quick notes or preferences.
  • User C, neither owner nor admin, cannot edit or delete the public group.
  • User B, the owner, can switch the group between public and personal, and can delete it.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Who can do what); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S10; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026. Also S6 (SV-10249, Manage tag groups), S6-E7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R6: “Only a tag group's owner can manage a personal tag group.”
  • S10-R7: “A tag group's owner and any admin can rename a public tag group, change its members or delete it. Only the owner can switch a group between public and personal.”
  • S6-E7: “When an admin edits another user's public group, the Public tag group toggle is shown on and disabled.”
  • S10-R8: “Only a quick note's owner can manage that quick note.”
  • S10-N2: “An admin has no access to another user's personal tag groups, quick notes or preferences.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
